messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "non-enteric coated form"
set: ["non-enteric coated form", "Form", "extended-release form", "one form of metoprolol", "sores form in mouth", "convert tramadol into active form", "liquid form is an oral suspension", "try a different brand or form", "converted into active form by CYP2D6", "if child has been prescribed the liquid form", "use only the brand and form prescribed by your doctor", "instead, a different form of the medicine should be used", "dose needs may change with different brand, strength, or form", "if you switch from immediate-release metoprolol to the extended-release form", "if one form suits you better than the other, tell your doctor", "check medicine each time you get a refill to ensure correct form"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
